name: passenger-name-input
title: Passenger Name Input
description: Passenger name field that checks against the ID and catches swapped names, a missing middle name, titles, suffixes or nicknames in the name, single-name passengers, accents the ticket can't print and names over the airline's limit, with fixes and a SURNAME/GIVEN TITLE readback.

meta.stops: Boarding denied over a ticket name
meta.summary: Checks a flight or train passenger name against the ID and reads it back as it will print, so a name mismatch doesn't cost a fee or a boarding.
catches: Middle name on the ID missing from the booking
Title, suffix or nickname typed into a name field
Single-name passengers, ticketed as repeat (JONES/JONES) or FNU
Accents or characters the ticket can't print, and names over maxLength
limits: Airline rules differ; defaults follow the airlines named in the code and should be checked for yours
Comparison with the ID only works when you pass idName
Doesn't change a booking already made
a11y: Title and name inputs have visible labels and are described by the hint and issues
Fix buttons are disabled while the result is stale
Focus moves to the next fix or the given-name field after a fix

rules.note: Not verified this round: airline single-name conventions (IndiGo, Air India, IATA AIRIMP FNU) and length limits come from the code's comments. Check with the airline.
